descriptions.s9_release_actor_inner_8013e458: Runs two cleanup helpers, releases the optional held interface and clears its pointer.
descriptions.s9_adjust_disable_8016d3ec: Null-checks and adjusts the object pointer to the preceding base, forwards the caller value and a constant enable flag, and returns zero.
descriptions.s9_invoke_callback_8017f5c8: Requires the ready flag, optionally runs the preparation helper, then calls the stored callback with its context or returns zero.
descriptions.s9_fill_values_8018d434: Obtains the writable element array and fills every entry from the supplied integer pointer, returning failure when the backing object is unavailable.
